name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Added 📥 Download button to save active wallpaper to Pictures folder as <category>_001.jpg, official Wallhaven API 4K integration, anti-duplication history sliding window, 14 categories with precision Trucks & Jeeps and Girls/Models)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Added '📥 Download' button in settings to save active wallpaper directly into Windows Pictures folder as <category>_001.jpg, <category>_002.jpg
Anti-Duplication History Cache: keeps sliding window of the last 100 wallpaper IDs with random 6-char seed on every search, eliminating duplicates
Official Wallhaven 4K API source: downloads pristine UHD/4K (3-15 MB) wallpapers with strict SFW purity=100
Girls, Models & Fashion precision: fixed Wallhaven categories=001 (People category) with 115,000+ real portraits and 0 trees
Trucks & Jeeps precision: dedicated category for trucks, pickups, jeeps, lorries, off-road jeeps with 100% vehicle accuracy
Full trilingual EN/CS/RU localization, minimal installer, silent uninstaller, and ~1.5-2 MB idle RAM consumption
